name: Approval without vote
title: RECOMMENDATION FOR SECOND READING on the Council position at first reading with a view to the adoption of a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on a mechanism to resolve legal and administrative obstacles in a cross-border context
part_text:
The European Parliament has approved a new European Union law that helps regions on either side of a national border work together. When a border creates legal or administrative problems, for example different rules that stop a shared project, this law sets up a way to solve them. Parliament accepted the version already agreed with the Council of the European Union, so no further changes were made. The law is called BRIDGEforEU, short for Border Regions' instrument for development and growth.

- **What changes:** A new mechanism lets border regions resolve legal and administrative obstacles blocking joint projects.
- **Who it affects:** People, businesses and public bodies in regions that share a border between EU countries.
- **What happens next:** The act is adopted; Parliament's and Council's presidents sign it, and it is published in the Official Journal.
